findings.description: In the new nothing-fitted block, `total_hunks=$(grep -c '^@@ ' FILE 2>/dev/null || echo 0)` and `kept_hunks=$(printf '%s\n' "$partial" | grep -c '^@@ ' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)` double-emit on a zero count: GNU grep -c prints `0` AND exits 1 when nothing matches, so `|| echo 0` appends a second `0` and the variable becomes the two-line string `0<LF>0`. A chunk with no `@@` lines is reachable (a `git diff --binary` literal patch, or a mode/rename-only section large enough to exceed the budget), and the same `|| echo 0` idiom is repeated on the `kept_hunks` line.
findings.failure_mode: The PARTIAL marker is meant to be one line the voice can read; with a zero count it renders as `(0\n0 of 0\n0 hunks; ...)`, splitting the marker across lines and injecting a bare `0` line into the diff body the model reviews. The `$_log_fn` line is likewise malformed. Cosmetic in the common case, but the marker is the only signal telling the voice the diff is incomplete.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the `|| echo 0` (grep already prints the count) and coerce instead: `total_hunks=$(grep -c '^@@ ' "$f" 2>/dev/null); total_hunks=${total_hunks:-0}` — or `|| true` followed by `[[ "$total_hunks" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || total_hunks=0`. Apply the same to `kept_hunks`.

findings.description: The partial-file fallback is gated on `included -eq 0`, so it only covers the case where every file overflowed. The greedy loop above it still skips a P0 file whose diff alone exceeds `max_tokens` and then fills the budget with lower-priority files (P2 config, P3 docs/tests) that do fit, listing the P0 file under `--- TRUNCATED ---`. The block's stated purpose is that a voice never reviews an incomplete diff as clean; in the mixed case the security-critical file is still omitted entirely while the voice receives a non-empty, apparently reviewable diff of the least important files.
findings.failure_mode: A sprint whose only large change is a `.sh` or `.claude/` script plus small doc/config edits produces a dissent that reviews the docs and reports the script only as 'omitted' — the exact silent-clean outcome the cycle-126 c1 C-001 finding was about, now shifted from the empty case to the mixed case. On this repo every script is P0, so a 60–90 KB script diff with a CHANGELOG line hits it.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply the hunk-boundary partial cut to the first skipped file that outranks (lower P number than) any included file, using the remaining budget (`max_tokens - current_tokens`) when that remainder is above a floor (e.g. 25% of the budget); alternatively, reserve the budget for the top-priority file first (partial if needed) and only then fill with lower-priority files. Keep the PARTIAL marker so the voice knows which hunks it did not see.
